rationale: C22 plausibly supplied a material template for the child. Both advocate comprehensive rather than piecemeal treatment of interrelated land-and-water problems, justify a temporary seven-member study commission, direct it to build on existing work and produce policy recommendations, and emphasize relating individual projects to a broader resource-development program. C24 strongly corroborates the shared administrative machinery, while C08 shares the immediate H.R. 5472 context but offers a narrower project-specific study argument.

shared_material.child_excerpt: these problems should be considered together, and met by comprehensive planning and action which recognizes the close inter-relationship of land and water and their manifold uses
shared_material.parent_excerpt: piece-meal or partial approaches to a problem as broad as water resources development tend to confuse... It is essential... that a comprehensive study and review be made
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same comprehensive-versus-piecemeal rationale for studying interconnected water and land-use issues.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The amendment would establish a study commission of seven members... The Commission would utilize all the studies which have been made already... The Commission's final report would be submitted in two years
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am creating by Executive order a temporary Water Resources Policy Commission of seven members to study and to make recommendations to me... much basic work has already been done... submit its final report to me not later than December 1, 1950
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts the parent's concrete commission structure: seven members, reliance on existing studies, recommendations, a deadline, and temporary status.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a whole range of projects which should be considered in relation to each other
shared_material.parent_excerpt: individual projects [must] be properly related to the total water resources program... undertaken in logical and orderly sequence
shared_material.explanation: Both frame individual water projects as components of an integrated regional or national program.
